relations.subject: GILCHRIST, John Borthwick
relations.evidence: After school in Edinburgh studies of medicine at George Heriot’s Hospital, Edinburgh.

relations.subject: GILCHRIST, John Borthwick
relations.evidence: Perry says that George Heriot’s Hospital funded his medical studies at Edinburgh University before he went to West Indies.

relations.subject: GILCHRIST, John Borthwick
relations.evidence: Gilchrist was made the principal of the new Fort William College, also responsible of its Hindūstānī department.

relations.subject: GILCHRIST, John Borthwick
relations.evidence: he was a short time Professor at East India College (then still in Hertford) in Febrary to May 1806.

relations.subject: GILCHRIST, John Borthwick
relations.evidence: In 1818 the Company decided that its people (surgeons in particular) should learn Hindūstānī before leaving for India. Therefore a chair was founded for Gilchrist at Oriental Institution (Leicester Square)

relations.subject: S. Arnot
relations.evidence: Gilchrist was allowed to teach until the end of 1826, then he was succeeded by S. Arnot and D. Forbes.
